SET 1.0 barg ASSUMED, TO SAFE LOC.
CONTROL VALVE, DIAPHRAGM; FO / FC = FAIL OPEN / CLOSED
PV PROCESS VAPOUR · PL PROCESS LIQUID · VG VACUUM GAS
NG NITROGEN · HO HOT OIL · TW TEMPERED WATER · CW COOLING WATER
1. ALTERNATIVE VERSION TO EPC STANDARD. THE SCREEN P&ID VBD-V1-PID-001 (P&ID TAB, TOP) STAYS THE REFERENCE FOR THE DCS, THE DECKS AND THE EXERCISES.
2. DESIGN CASE (OTS MODEL, NOISE OFF, START OF CAMPAIGN AT TOTAL REFLUX): TOP 160 mbar a (PIC-102), POT 170.9 mbar a, COLUMN ΔP 10.9 mbar, FLOODING 61 %;
POT DUTY 3.0 kW (JIC-101); HOT OIL 290 °C (TIC-107); TEMPERED WATER 60 °C, 1.2 m³/h; CHARGE 110 L = 95.7 kg FAME (89 % LEVEL HOT, 133 L AT 255 °C).
3. TOTAL REFLUX: TI-104 192.4, TI-103 193.3, TI-102 239, POT 255.9 °C; OVERHEAD 31.7 kg/h (MW 214); E-103 LOAD 2.37 kW; REFLUX 31.8 kg/h.
4. CAMPAIGN A: OFF-CUT R 15 → TK-201, PRODUCT CUT R 10 → TK-202 (C16:0 ≥ 99.0 wt %). SWITCH 307 min, END 907 min; TK-201 11.1 kg, TK-202 34.7 kg,
RECOVERY 80.7 %; RESIDUE 45.5 kg STAYS IN D-101. MASS BALANCE CLOSES TO 0.002 % (eng_check.py).
5. VAPOUR-PRESSURE ANCHORS, ΔHv, PACKING CAPACITY, CONDENSER UA, POT HEAT LOSS ARE ASSUMED IN THE MODEL (TBC).
6. LINE SIZES PRELIMINARY (TBC). OVERHEAD DN40: 7.6 m/s, 0.12 mbar/m (DN25 WOULD GIVE 17.9 m/s, 1.1 mbar/m). LIQUID LINES AT MINIMUM SIZE.
7. ALL VESSELS SEE VACUUM: DESIGN FV / 1.0 barg ASSUMED (HOLD); MATERIALS TBC. ESTER LINES TRACED / INSULATED ABOVE 45 °C (ESTERS FREEZE 30–38 °C), TBC.
8. PRESSURE AND LEVEL INSTRUMENTS C/W ROOT AND TEST VALVES (TYP., NOT SHOWN). PUMP MOTORS AND CASING DRAINS NOT SHOWN.
9. NEW TAGS ON THIS SET: V-101…V-122, NRV-101/102/104/108/112, FT-101, TT-101, LINE NUMBERS. ALL OTHER TAGS ARE THE OTS TAGS, UNCHANGED.
10. CHARGE METHOD, RECEIVER VENT / EQUALISING LINE, VT-101 COOLING AND DRAINING: TBC.
11. FIELD TRANSMITTERS (CIRCLE) ARE DRAWN SEPARATE FROM DCS FUNCTIONS (BAR) AND SIS-100 FUNCTIONS (SQUARE). AS IN THE MODEL, PSHH-102 SHARES PT-102
AND LSLL-101 SHARES LT-101 WITH THE DCS; TSHH-101 HAS ITS OWN ELEMENT TE-101B.
12. SIS-100 TRIPS (DELAY): TSHH-101 > 290 °C (5 s) · PSHH-102 > 300 mbar (5 s, RUN) · FSLL-108 < 0.36 m³/h (10 s, RUN) · LSLL-101 < 20 % (5 s, RUN) ·
TSHH-107 > 330 °C (5 s) · HS-100. ACTIONS, PERMISSIVES AND RESET: INTERLOCK SCHEDULE ON VBD-PID-002.
13. LSLL-104 < 5 % FOR 5 s STOPS P-104 (PUMP PROTECTION IN THE BPCS, NOT A SIF).
14. FAIL POSITIONS: PV-102 FO (N₂ BLEED OPEN; TOP SETTLES ≈ 300 mbar = PSHH-102), FV-104 FO (REFLUX KEPT), FV-105 FC (NO DRAW-OFF),
XV-101 / TV-101 FC (VBD-PID-002). XV-107 STAYS PUT AND HV-105 FO: ASSUMED (TBC).
15. PIC-102 → PV-102. LIC-104 → RY-104 → SET POINTS OF FIC-104 (R/(R+1)) AND FIC-105 (1/(R+1)). HS-107 → XV-107: CLOSED / TK-201 / TK-202; A TRIP SETS CLOSED.
16. HV-110 N₂ VACUUM BREAK ONLY WITH THE POT BELOW 150 °C (PROCEDURE TODAY).
17. DASHED ITEMS ARE RECOMMENDED BY THE HAZOP AND SAFETY-LAYERS TABS AND DO NOT EXIST: PSV-101, RD-102 + PSV-102, PT-102B, LT-101B, TZ-110 (HOLD).
RELIEF SET 1.0 barg ASSUMED; SIZE TO API 520/521 ONCE MAWP AND N₂ REGULATOR PRESSURE ARE KNOWN (HOLD).
18. RO-102 (N₂), TSV-103 (E-103 WATER SIDE), AT-102 (O₂) AND FA-101 ARE FURTHER RECOMMENDATIONS IN THE SAFETY-LAYERS TAB, NOT DRAWN.
SHEET 1 OF 2 · PROCESS: C-101, D-101, D-102, OVERHEAD, RECEIVERS, VACUUM
